content.short: Cat ID Paws is a 'Swipe-to-Earn' game on TON where players interact with cat-themed mechanics to earn tokens.
content.description: Cat ID Paws is an innovative 'Swipe-to-Earn' social game built on the TON blockchain and accessible via Telegram. It invites players to interact with a charming cat-themed interface, using intuitive swipe mechanics to accumulate points and earn $PAWS tokens. The game also features unique NFT collections that provide utility and enhance the player's earning potential. By combining cute aesthetics with rewarding Web3 incentives, Cat ID Paws has become a popular destination for casual gamers and NFT collectors within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Swipe and earn with Cat ID Paws on TON. Cat-themed gaming and NFTs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
